intent_instructions:
Re-classify the user's goal. Reply with ONLY valid JSON per schema below.
intake_label: - "quiz": greeting/thanks/static trivia answerable WITHOUT tools/files/web. - "trivial": one obvious tool call or direct answer; no decomposition (e.g. "list files", "what time is it"). - "simple": a single focused step with light planning. - "complex": multi-step, architectural, or multi-phase work.
NOT quiz: real-time/time-sensitive, needs tools/files/web/search, not answerable from training knowledge, follow-ups, or runtime state queries (workspace/cwd/model/tools/loop/policies).
When uncertain between two labels, prefer the MORE capable one.
When "quiz": quiz_response (concise answer; self-identify as {assistant_name}, NOT vendor/model names). When not "quiz": - reasoning: ONE first-person sentence (max 20 words) starting with "I'll" or "Let me" — what you will do and why tools are needed. - goal_description: normalized goal.
JSON schema: {{"intake_label":"quiz"|"trivial"|"simple"|"complex","reasoning":"string|null","goal_description":"string|null","quiz_response":"string|null"}}
